# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery and shopping platform enabling users to find and save creative ideas through Pins, with comprehensive business tools, advertising solutions, and developer APIs.

Pinterest serves consumers, creators, and businesses with tools for content discovery, creation, and marketing. The platform offers Pinterest Business for advertising, Pinterest API for developers, Analytics for performance tracking, and extensive help resources for all user types.

## Key Topics

- Pins
- Pinterest Business
- Pinterest API
- Pinterest Conversions API
- Pinterest Tag
- Pinterest API for Shopping
- Pinterest ads
- Pinterest Performance+
- Pinterest Predicts
- Content creation
- Visual discovery
- Business advertising
- Developer platform
- Analytics and tracking
- Creator tools

## Core Platform

- [Pinterest](https://pinterest.com/_=_): Main Pinterest landing page with login and signup authentication
- [Skip to content - Pinterest](https://pinterest.com/us): Pinterest US homepage for discovering and saving creative ideas
- [Today's Top Trends on Pinterest](https://pinterest.com/today): Daily curated trending content and seasonal inspiration on Pinterest
- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas): Browse curated ideas by category from Animals to Wedding planning
- [Pinterest South Africa](https://za.pinterest.com/web/index/index): Pinterest South Africa regional homepage and landing page

## Business & Advertising

- [Pinterest Business](https://business.pinterest.com): Main business marketing platform for Pinterest ads and brand solutions
- [Pinterest Analytics](https://analytics.pinterest.com): Analytics dashboard for tracking Pin performance and audience insights
- [Pinterest Ads](https://ads.pinterest.com/expert): Free ads consultation program with Pinterest advertising experts
- [How Pinterest Works](https://business.pinterest.com/how-pinterest-works): How Pinterest works as a visual discovery and shopping platform

## Creator Platform

- [Pinterest Create](https://create.pinterest.com): Creator platform for brands, merchants, and publishers to create content
- [Get Started with Pinterest Create](https://create.pinterest.com/get-started): Getting started guide for creating content and setting up accounts

## Developer Resources

- [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com): Pinterest API documentation for content, ads, and shopping integration
- [Pinterest Developers Platform](https://dev.pinterest.com): Developer platform for Pinterest API, Conversions API, and Tag integration

## Help & Support

- [All about Pinterest](https://help.pinterest.com/en/guide/all-about-pinterest): Beginner's guide explaining Pinterest basics and platform overview
- [Can't log in to Pinterest](https://help.pinterest.com/en/article/cant-log-in-to-pinterest): Login troubleshooting and account recovery help for Pinterest users
- [Age verification](https://help.pinterest.com/en/article/age-verification-appeals): Age verification process and appeals for Pinterest account access
- [Reactivate your account](https://help.pinterest.com/en/article/reactivate-your-account): Account reactivation steps for deactivated Pinterest accounts

## Careers

- [Engineering | Pinterest Careers](https://engineering.pinterest.com): Pinterest engineering team careers and job opportunities
